Name: Kigakeun's Alex HD Anime Portrait
Author: Kigakeun
Description:
Created for my own game and felt like sharing. I made these portraits with the intention of trying to match other HD anime portrait packs such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15199]Anime HD Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15512]Anime HD SVE Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15850]HD Portraits for Ridgeside Village[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15671]HD Anime Ridgeside Village Portraits[/url].

Features seasonal and festival variants. All outfits are simply what I wanted to put him in and are not based on any other seasonal portrait mod.

I made two extra Spirit's Eve costumes for Alex - Spiderman and Tuxedo Mask from Sailor Moon - however, I began to wonder if this was against some kind of copyright, even though I'm not selling these. Until someone can clarify this for me, check the comments section for a link to these.

Customizable! If you prefer a different outfit for a season or festival, just rename the files.

[center]♡♡♡[/center]

[size=6][u][b]INSTALLATION:
[/b][/u][/size]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and its requirements.
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url].
(Portraiture currently does not support seasonal portraits - PortraiturePlus fixes this)﻿
3. Create a new folder inside [i]Mods\Portraiture\Portraits [/i]if you haven't already, titled whatever you want.
4. Extract the .png files into the new folder.
(Choose ONE summer portrait and ONE Spirit's Eve portrait and discard the rest)

[b][u][size=6]PERMISSIONS﻿:
[/size][/u][/b]Permissions are [b]OPEN[/b]. If you want to improve on my portraits or add more for other mods, please feel free!

Due to the mod author's rules, my portraits may NOT be used with the designs from [b]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/b]. You would need to come up with your own outfit designs to make a seasonal portrait expansion.

Downloads.Description:
Just a reupload in case files were corrupted, since a few people are having issues.

However, these are just pictures and unlikely to be the problem, so make sure you installed correctly and reinstall Portraiture and SMAPI if experiencing issues.
